title: EmoLASP: Emotion Recognition with Language Models and Answer Set Programming
abstract: arXiv:2608.29035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversations is increasingly tackled with language models, but these models can be unstable and expensive to fine-tune or to prompt with long dialogue histories. We propose EmoLASP, a framework that combines a language model with declarative reasoning via Answer Set Programming (ASP) to predict VAD scores (Valence-Arousal-Dominance) in conversations. Experiments on a widely used benchmark dataset (IEMOCAP) across six open-source LLMs (3B-120B) and two PLMs (BERT, RoBERTa) show that EmoLASP improves prediction performance compared to using the language model alone, even when the LLMs/PLMs are given no dialogue history in their prompts or input vectors. The gains are largest for prompt-only LLMs, which EmoLASP uses without any fine-tuning. However, for fine-tuned PLMs, the reasoner adds little once dialogue history is available. translated_title: EmoLASP：基于语言模型与回答集编程的情感识别
translated_abstract: 对话中的情感识别越来越多地采用语言模型来解决，但这些模型可能不稳定，且微调或在提示中加入长对话历史的成本高昂。我们提出了EmoLASP，这是一个将语言模型与通过回答集编程（ASP）实现的声明式推理相结合的框架，用于预测对话中的VAD分数（效价-唤醒-支配度）。在一个广泛使用的基准数据集（IEMOCAP）上，对六个开源大语言模型（3B-120B）和两个预训练语言模型（BERT、RoBERTa）的实验表明，与单独使用语言模型相比，EmoLASP提升了预测性能，即使在LLM/PLM的提示或输入向量中不提供对话历史的情况下也是如此。对于仅通过提示使用的LLM收益最大，EmoLASP无需任何微调即可使用它们。然而，对于经过微调的PLM，一旦对话历史可用，推理器带来的增益就很有限。EmoLASP的LLM流程展示了使用推理方法的潜在优势。
tldr: EmoLASP框架将语言模型与回答集编程（ASP）声明式推理相结合，无需微调即可显著提升对话中VAD情感分数的预测性能，对仅使用提示的大语言模型效果最佳。
en_tdlr: EmoLASP combines language models with declarative reasoning via Answer Set Programming to improve VAD emotion prediction in conversations, achieving the largest gains with prompt-only LLMs without any fine-tuning.
